text.headline: The Geographic Arc
text.text: Koutian Wu's path: USTC in Hefei, Shenzhen X-Institute, NSF NCAR in Boulder, industry stops in Beijing, and a UT Austin PhD building explainable AI inside Noah-MP.

text.headline: Hefei / USTC
text.text: B.S. with Honors in Geological and Earth Sciences at the University of Science and Technology of China, 2020–2024. Founded the Xingyun Poetry Club at age 17.

text.headline: Shenzhen / X-Institute
text.text: Student Fellow at the Shenzhen X-Institute, October 2021 – February 2024. Featured in People's Daily Overseas Edition (May 2025) and Tsinghua University news.

text.headline: Boulder / NSF NCAR
text.text: Visiting Scholar with the WACCM-X group, July – December 2023. Hunga–Tonga eruption signature in the MLT region (AGU 2023, SA33B-2892).

text.headline: Beijing / Industry
text.text: 2025 internships: AI Agent Evaluation Engineer at PineAI; Full-Stack LLM Developer at Beijing ZaiwenAI Technology Co., Ltd.

text.headline: Austin / UT Austin
text.text: Jackson School of Geosciences PhD (2025–2029 expected) with Zong-Liang Yang. NSF NCAR allocation UTAA0012 on Derecho-GPU: Explainable AI for Noah-MP.
